description: exp026 - exact clone of exp024 (single-stream + Linear head, anchor_pairs hyperplane init, hard forward) with ONE change: reduced tables-per-head at all three backbone LUT sites, nap unchanged: qk_lut tph 256->32, v_lut tph 256->32, out_proj tph 512->64 (~8x fewer tables everywhere). Everything else byte-identical to exp024: seed 42, 16000 steps, 24576 tok/step, Lion 2e-4 tables / AdamW 3e-4 rest (hyperplanes no-wd, Linear head wd 0.1), warmup 1600 cosine to 0.1x floor, grad clip 1.0, 6L/E384/6h x d_qk=d_v=64/ctx512/vocab32768/RoPE1e4/untied tok_emb, LayerNorm everywhere. Measures how far the table capacity can be cut before val_bpb degrades. Baseline exp024 1.2034 (276.6M params).
